title: Vera and Anna who were lucky to find you
text: We had only 3 days in Barcelona and decided to do our first segway tour. Leo met us in the office of RoboCity and explained all the details and routes. Pretty fast we realized that we were very lucky to discover exactly this place. We wanted to go away from the typical touristic routes, so our guide Pau brought us to Montjuic Mountain. It was a great afternoon and Pau, who is a Catalonian, told us a lot of interesting facts about Catalunya's history, sports and architecture and answered all our questions. title: Best fun in Barcelona with your clothes on
text:
Firstly, we booked this using the ‘Get your guide’ app. It made booking things before we set off very very easy. Not sure which package we actually booked but we had a 3 hour tour around Barcelona on the Segway. Never used one before but our guide Nuno gave us a quick guide and made sure we were happy before setting off. Don’t worry, after 5-10 mins, it feels natural. 
Firstly - touring Barcelona by Segway is pretty much the best way of seeing the sights without getting sore and tired feet. I’m seriously considering booking this again tomorrow.

title: The best guide ever with Nuno
text: the trip was great, we visited many wonderful places such as the Parliament of Catalonia or the Catalan Arch in the center, and our guide, Nuno, talked brilliantly, creatively and comprehensively about them. Mr. Nuno is a very nice and helpful man who willingly answers our questions. Operating the Segway was not easy at the beginning, but with sometimes it was easy and pleasant. I personally highly recommend the trip
author: 338yassine

title: Beautiful Barcelona tour
text:
Good:
We had the 3hr Barcelona e scooter tour, I have taken a lot of tours In all over Europe but this was by far by the best, our tour guide Zarina was extremely knowledgeable he knew every detail and history about the whole tour
SHe was always open to take questions and would answer them nicely and in detail
Bad:
They really raised the standard of tour guides which I would look for in everyone but don’t think I will find this sort of professionalism
author: muneebarif

title: Blast
text: Had a blast riding a Segway for the first time. The beginning (training) was a bit intimidating but it did not take long to learn to ride enough that you get much more comfortable over time. Saw lots of areas and the guide, Mario, was very informative and pleasant. Rode a long time and even in the evening. If you want to see a wide area of Barcelona (my first time) you’ll have a blast.
author: SharkDiver007

title: Great tour of Barcelona
text: We took a 3 hour private tour with Carlo.  He was a great tour guide. Very friendly and he knew a lot about what we were seeing on the tour. His English was very good. I will say that the equipment has seen better days,  but it was not unsafe. I would recommend his tour.
author: Karyn_H
